name: Terrestrial invertebrates
description: Ants, mites and millipedes falling or washed from the flooded forest into the river - a flood-pulse subsidy from land to water. Functional group aggregating the terrestrial-invertebrate families measured together by the source (Eremobelbidae, Formicidae, Fuhrmannodesmidae, Hypochthoniidae, Paradoxomatidae, Pseudonannolenidae, Pyrgodesmidae).
